item.title: Black lung disease mortality on the rise, recent analysis shows - CHEST Physician
item.description: CDC experts David N. Weissman, MD, FCCP, and Jacek Mazurek, MD, PhD, said that identifying dust exposure is key to improving outcomes for patients with coal workers’ pneumoconiosis.

item.title: Adult bronchiectasis guidelines updated to reflect emerging evidence on disease identification and management - CHEST Physician
item.description: New bronchiectasis recommendations from the European Respiratory Society reflect a shift toward individualized, risk-based care, recognizing diverse inflammatory and microbiologic profiles. The guidelines emphasize early identification of high-risk patients, multidimensional assessment, and universal airway clearance training.

item.title: Top reads from the CHEST journal portfolio – March 2026 - CHEST Physician
item.description: Read new research from the journal portfolio on dietary interventions in patients with fibrotic ILD, rapid metagenomic sequencing of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, and corticosteroid regimens for COVID-19 with ARDS.

item.title: Light therapy to improve sleep in older patients with dementia - CHEST Physician
item.description: A comprehensive approach combining light therapy with daytime physical activity and sleep-wake scheduling has significant benefits for patients with dementia.

item.title: Beyond ‘doing everything’: Moral distress, burnout, and the emotional toll of ICU care - CHEST Physician
item.description: ICU burnout and morally distressing end-of-life care are intertwined, making improved end-of-life care both a patient imperative and a clinician necessity.

item.title: A ‘central’ issue in sleep medicine - CHEST Physician
item.description: An AASM task force recently published guidelines on central sleep apnea management, which includes recommendations on whether adaptive servo-ventilation is a safe option in these patients.

item.title: Inside the 2025 CPR and ECC guideline updates from the AHA - CHEST Physician
item.description: Ashish Panchal, MD, PhD, and Daniel Arellano, PhD, RN, APRN, ACNP-BC, review new guidelines that prioritize improved survival rates and neurological outcomes.

item.title: Intranasal saline improves symptoms in children with sleep-disordered breathing - CHEST Physician
item.description: The results of the MIST+ trial support the conclusion that saline is as effective as corticosteroid in managing symptoms of OSDB, said lead author Gillian Nixon, MD.

item.title: Bilateral lung transplant comparable to heart-lung transplant in primary PAH - CHEST Physician
item.description: Recent findings reinforce the widely used strategy of bilateral lung transplantation for most patients with primary PAH who do not have structural heart disease.

item.title: Biologic therapies in asthma: From foundation to the future - CHEST Physician
item.description: Biologic therapies are changing severe asthma management, shifting the goal from control to remission. Diego J. Maselli, MD, FCCP; Dharani Narendra, MD, FCCP; and Megan Conroy, MD, MAEd, FCCP, explore their impact in this installment of Clinical Outlook in Pulmonology.
